description: FX rate must resolve for every row (unknown currency or missing rate)
currency must be one of the governed ISO codes
posted_date must be between 2000-01-01 and the day after the run date
transaction_id must be present on every row
transaction_id must be unique within the batch after deduplication
the newest posted_date in the batch must be within N days of the run date
batch row count must be within tolerance of the prior batch
customer_id should exist in dim_customer (current version)
credit-normal accounts (revenue, liability, equity) must not carry positive debit amounts on sale events
customer_id should be present on sale and payment events
transaction_id must follow the TXN-<12 digits> pattern
amount_local must be within plausible bounds
